                            Dear Jeffrey,
                            I wanted to update you on our placebo
                            initiative at Harvard. I've been asked to
                            start a Harvard-wide Program in Placebo
                            Studies which will be hosted at the Beth
                            Israel Deaconess Medical Center. It will
                            do basic, clinical and social science research
                            as well as scholarly work in placebo studies.
                             We are situated in all the major teaching
                            hospitals at Harvard and have already
                            drawn commitments from over 20 faculty.
                            Anne Harrington will be joining us. We
                            recently published an physiological study of
                            placebo in the New England Journal of
                            Medicine and a theoretical paper in
                            Philosophic Transactions of the Roy Soc B.
                              (I'm attaching 44). We anticipate making
                            some major breakthroughs in genetic of
                            placebo effects (we're submitting our
                            findings in the next days) and have major
                            studies in the pipeline. We're hoping that
